name: Scottsdale Airport

runway.v: one runway, 3/21, 8,249 ft (about 2,514 m) x 100 ft; the city noted a runway closure 24-31 Oct (2026)

max_aircraft.v: runway weight limit 75,000 lb maximum certificated take-off weight; aircraft up to 100,000 lb MTOW may operate above 75,000 lb only with prior permission

ppr.v: aircraft operating above 75,000 lb (MTOW 75,001-100,000 lb) need PPR on the Heavy Aircraft Operation PPR form, via Airport Operations

curfew.v: voluntary curfew 22:00-06:00 local (05:00-13:00 UTC; Arizona keeps UTC-7 all year); not a ban

noise.v: touch-and-goes banned 21:30-06:00 and engine run-ups banned 22:00-07:00; intersection take-offs prohibited; non-Stage 3 aircraft asked to depart runway 3
noise.quote: Touch-and-go operations prohibited between 9:30 p.m. and 6 a.m.

customs.v: US Customs daily 09:00-19:00 local (16:00-02:00 UTC); the user fee must be prepaid online before arrival
customs.quote: U.S. Customs service is currently available daily from 9 a.m. to 7 p.m.

notes: Read City of Scottsdale airport pages: Pilot Information (last updated 31 Jul 2026), Noise Abatement Procedures (29 May 2024), General Information (14 Oct 2026, shows IATA 'SDL'). Pilot Information gives customs as 1600Z-0200Z and the voluntary curfew as 0500Z-1300Z; I converted with UTC-7 (Arizona, no summer time), matching the 9 a.m.-7 p.m. and 10 p.m.-6 a.m. local times on the other pages. Runway 03/21 closure 'Oct. 24 - 31' shown without year on 28 Oct 2026; check NOTAMs. CBP fact sheet (https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2025-06/KSDL%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020250606.pdf) could not be opened. FAA Chart Supplement / d-TPP (aeronav.faa.gov), FAA NFDC airport data (nfdc.faa.gov, robots-blocked) and ADIP (adip.faa.gov) could not be opened. Metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
